body:
Firmware-only standby improvements. Not for merge until hardware-tested.

- src/gps_power.h: UBX-RXM-PMREQ (v0, backup, uartrx wake) builder + wake retry timing. Flag TACTICPOD_GPS_BACKUP_STANDBY default 0; env tacticpod_reusable_usb_gpsbackup (compile-checked in CI).
- gps_receiver.cpp: PMREQ before Serial1.end(); on wake 0xFF pulses every 1 s (max 8); existing profile audit restores 10 Hz; recording still gated on verified profile.
- Idle D0 poll 50 -> 100 ms (10 ms while pressed); hold 3000 ms unchanged.
- Tests/docs updated. Not implemented: VBUS standby, slower battery poll, IMU rail cut, System OFF.
- Unmeasured: savings are estimates; wake mask (0x08 vs ubxlib 0xE4) and V_BCKP need hardware verification.
title: Standby power: opt-in GPS backup standby, slower idle poll
head: standby-power-optimisation
